summary: Big week for disclosure watchers. American Airlines pilots reported a close encounter with unidentified bright objects over Texas, drawing fresh FAA attention. Meanwhile on the Hill, Rep. Burlison dropped a bombshell — classified UAP videos shown to Congress reportedly depict objects that "defy physics," and he's now questioning an alleged massive overseas UAP structure. Defense Secretary Hegseth doubled down on the Trump administration's promise to release Pentagon UFO files, noting AARO's caseload has officially cracked 2,000 reports. Skeptics, however, point to a long history of promises that went nowhere. All eyes remain on whether Trump's declassification directive translates into actual document drops in the weeks ahead. We're tracking 19 events and hearings, 28 news items, and counting.
